response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS ov FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a, o.ov FROM t CROSS JOIN o WHERE t.a > o.ov), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m1 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.telescref, k1.a, k1.ov, m.m1 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m WHERE k1.a > m.m1) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(a - ov) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(a - m1) AS avg_above_second_avg FROM k2
